A focused __tests__/RequestBuilder.test.tsx (13 tests) exercises the /api/v1 prefix, path-param substitution + encodeURIComponent query assembly, query default seeding, immediate GET send (body undefined + empty headers), trimmed X-API-Key header, the non-GET two-step confirm (first tap opens strip + interpolated {{method}} message resolved, confirm sends, cancel closes without sending), requestBody example seeding + the '{\n  \n}' template, the conditional path/query/body panels + always-present auth panel, summary/description rendering with duplicate-description hiding, and the loading-disabled/relabelled Send button.
